summary: All five Round-1 findings are accepted in Round 3 with no residual concerns. The revisions land cleanly: (f1) R10's runtime enforcement + AC-12 are dropped, leaving documentation-level read-only via R10 + AC-11; (f2) R2 is a single-rule fixpoint with bump-iteration discipline + chain-don't-absorb extraction to templates/task/sprint-bucket-heuristic.md; (f3) R9 / AC-4 dropped, property kept as R2 corollary + R12/AC-15 eval-coverage (independently motivated by GD-r1-f1); (f4) R7 reshaped as behavioural property + execution-order fixture (independently motivated by goal-driven-r1-f3); (f5) typed comparator over (int, optional-letter) grammar is stronger than my original 'numeric suffix' proposal because it correctly handles 029's T-3.A / T-3.B split-suffix case. No re-opens; no sharpens needed.
